create_AIStudioClient: create an AIStudioClient instance with a Gemini model name and optional safety settings
sample_text_prompt: sample text from a Gemini model using a prompt string with configurable temperature and max tokens
configure_safety_settings: configure Gemini API safety settings to block harassment, hate speech, explicit, and dangerous content
enable_rate_limit_sleep: enable periodic 10-second sleeps between API calls to avoid rate limiting
truncate_response: truncate the model response text using configurable terminator delimiters
